queries:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS total
  FROM income
  GROUP BY link_to_member
),
s AS (
  SELECT link_to_member, total, total * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total) FROM t) AS share
  FROM t
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s
)
SELECT SUM(s.total) AS sum_total,
       AVG(s.share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_diff
FROM s, a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;
SELECT AVG(COALESCE(t.total, 0))
FROM member m
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS total
    FROM income
    GROUP BY link_to_member
) t ON m.member_id = t.link_to_member;
SELECT link_to_member,
       SUM(amount) AS total_amount,
       SUM(amount) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income) AS share,
       AVG(SUM(amount) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income)) OVER () AS avg_share
FROM income
GROUP BY link_to_member;
SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS total_amount
FROM income
WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY link_to_member
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, SUM(amount)
FROM income
WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL
